\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\ii}{\mathrm{i}}
\newcommand{\Lor}[1]{\frac{2\Gamma}{#1^2+\Gamma^2}}
\title{A broadened level and its bath integrals (synthetic demo)}
\begin{document}
Synthetic public demo: textbook identities for a level broadened by a
wide-band bath. It is not a research manuscript. We use $\Gamma>0$,
$\beta>0$ and
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:zdef}
z_\pm(x) = \frac12 + \frac{\beta(\Gamma \pm \ii x)}{2\pi} .
\end{equation}
The Lorentzian splits into a retarded and an advanced pole,
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:split}
\Lor{\omega} = \frac{\ii}{\omega + \ii\Gamma} - \frac{\ii}{\omega - \ii\Gamma},
\end{equation}
and decays as
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:tail}
\Lor{\omega} = \frac{2\Gamma}{\omega^2} + \mathcal{O}(\omega^{-4}) .
\end{equation}
Closing the contour in both half planes,
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:pair}
\int d\omega\, \frac{n_F(\omega)}{(\omega - a + \ii\Gamma)(\omega - b - \ii\Gamma)}
 = \frac{\ii\pi + \psi(z_-(b)) - \psi(z_+(a))}{b - a + 2\ii\Gamma},
\end{equation}
and for the average over two advanced poles one finds
\begin{equation}
\label{eq:pair-wrong}
\int d\omega\, \frac{n_F(\omega)}{(\omega - a - \ii\Gamma)(\omega - b - \ii\Gamma)}
 = \frac{\psi(z_+(a)) - \psi(z_+(b))}{a - b} .
\end{equation}
\end{document}
